up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the target with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL4296. For each activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID (prefer this over DOI, falling back to DOI if PubMed ID is missing), assay description, and the IC50 measurement details (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment). Only return rows where the compound has a canonical SMILES defined and at least one PubMed ID or DOI is available.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs ON cr.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL);
